metadata.tagline: Empowering Teams with Real-Time Project Insights
metadata.description: Pulseboard is a SaaS startup founded in early 2023, offering an intelligent dashboard platform for project managers and distributed teams. It aggregates tasks, deadlines, and team communication into actionable insights, improving transparency and productivity. After acquiring its first paying customers, Pulseboard aims to scale, refine its product, and expand its reach.

roadmap.narrative_description: Pulseboard releases a beta version of its AI-powered task suggestions, allowing select customers to test automated prioritization and workflow enhancements.
The team conducts focused interviews and surveys with early users, collecting valuable feedback on usability and feature gaps to guide product improvements.
Pulseboard lands a contract with a mid-sized marketing agency, marking its first significant B2B client and opening doors to new industry segments.
The company unveils a new brand identity and an upgraded website, enhancing its positioning and marketing assets for broader outreach.
Pulseboard secures $600,000 in seed funding, enabling accelerated hiring and development. The milestone is celebrated with internal planning sessions.
New hires join the development and customer success teams, scaling Pulseboard's capacity to support more clients and iterate faster.
Pulseboard launches its public API, allowing customers to integrate with Slack, Trello, and other productivity tools, driving adoption among tech-savvy teams.
Automated onboarding workflows are released, reducing friction for new users and improving conversion rates from trial to paid plans.
Pulseboard completes its first external security audit, implements GDPR compliance upgrades, and reassures clients with transparent reporting.
The company hosts a virtual summit, bringing together clients, partners, and staff to share best practices and gather feedback for the coming year.
Pulseboard faces its first notable churn spike, prompting a cross-functional task force to diagnose causes and implement retention strategies.
Pulseboard launches its dedicated mobile app for iOS and Android, expanding accessibility and boosting user engagement as it enters its third year.
